online_detail: Messages and status are up to date.
no_network_detail: This device has no network right now. It reconnects on its own once the network is back.
restarting_detail: The hub is restarting (a new version or a planned restart). It drops for a moment and reconnects on its own.
unreachable_detail: The network is up, but the hub can't be reached (its computer may be off, asleep or offline). It keeps retrying on its own.
not_done_hub: Can't reach the hub. That didn't go through
not_done_network: No network. That didn't go through
